newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso closes higher as c bank sells.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso closes higher as c bank sells.

text.p: The Philippine peso gained at the close on Thursday, helped by the central bank's dollar sales, traders said.
The central bank dominated trading, accounting for almost half of the day's volume of $34.5 million. It was selling at the rates of 28.40/28.50, traders said.
The peso ended at 28.47 to dollar from the previous close of 28.
"Almost all banks were biddish on the dollar. No one wanted to sell," a foreign bank dealer said.
